name: ob1-jev
comment: The typed-decision tier's serving process (SMD-2050). onnxruntime-node runs the model; its postinstall only fetches CUDA provider binaries, which the CPU provider does not use, and Bun leaves it untrusted — do not add it to trustedDependencies. @huggingface/tokenizers is the tokenizer alone (zero dependencies), not transformers.js.
